installCommand: if [ -f apps/grid-monitor/package.json ]; then npm ci --include=dev; else npm ci --prefix ../.. --include=dev; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f apps/grid-monitor/package.json ]; then npm --prefix apps/grid-monitor run build && rm -rf dist && cp -R apps/grid-monitor/dist ./dist; else npm --prefix ../grid-monitor run build && rm -rf dist && cp -R ../grid-monitor/dist ./dist; fi
